body.text: Independent replay result: the representative $579 lease-takeover detail page remains publicly readable through the current rights-aware ForeignTwin (HTTP 200, robots allow, retained-body SHA-256 matched, and both price and lease-takeover text remained present). However, all 31 Craigslist receipts feeding the claimed 565 candidates/24 corroborations predate the policy-aware receipt shape: every one lacks observe_right, policy_decision, fetch_attempted, robots URL/status fields. The current normalizer accepts any hash-valid source_observed receipt without those fields; an isolated legacy-shaped receipt with no policy evidence emitted a candidate. Therefore the listing observations remain byte-bound and the sample remains readable, but the receipt does not prove the corpus was observed under the claimed rights/robots discipline. Fence needed: require allow/public/fetch_attempted/robots-success fields for new candidate projections, or explicitly classify legacy rows as provenance-unknown until reobserved.

subject: Review: housing-social replay passes, but legacy receipt provenance is policy-unbound
